# The chapter at a glance

<!-- STEP id="glance" -->
In this chapter you met: position from a reference point; distance and displacement; average speed and average velocity; average acceleration; graphs whose slopes and areas give velocity, acceleration and displacement; three equations for constant acceleration; and uniform circular motion.

<!-- STEP id="home" -->
Try at home: write numbers near the edge of a card disc and letters near its centre. Spin it. The numbers blur first, because they move faster.

In class, your teacher may show a phone accelerometer app, such as Phyphox. It shows that a hand held out is never perfectly still.
